verdict.rationale: monday.com's docs describe an extensive agent framework with triggers (message/assign/mention, item creation, column changes), sandboxed autonomous execution on managed infra, scoped permissions, and cross-channel reachability — strong vendor claims of autonomous background automation. However, all evidence is vendor documentation with no independent/community confirmation of real-world autonomous reliability, and community feedback about the core platform raises general reliability concerns (slowness, data loss) that create doubt about production-grade autonomous execution.
